{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVRCof88AAAABa9dHpg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn7ElzhEi02Q", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn7El", "number": 113, "title": "Continue #111: reproduce Alice no Yakata 3 HDI FreeDOS(98) boot hang using verified local-only archive source", "body": "## Problem

[Issue #111](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/issues/111) was administratively closed after [PR #112](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/pull/112), although that PR and [`docs/hdd-boot-investigation.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/docs/hdd-boot-investigation.md) explicitly say the actual reported `aliceY3.hdi` boot hang remains **unresolved**. The baseline legal FreeDOS HDD already reached an interactive shell both before and after PR #112; no demonstrated cause of the private-image hang was fixed.

**New user-supplied provenance (2026-10-29):** the user identifies the exact archive from which their `aliceY3.hdi` was extracted:

- Source archive: **https://d1.alicefree.fastlast.org/d/alice_yakata3.zip**
- Publisher's listing: **https://alicefree.fastlast.org/**, under **`アリスの館3(PC-98版)`**, whose ZIP link points to that exact URL (distinct from the separately listed `ALICEの館3(CDディスクイメージ)` archive).
- Rights holder's **official conditional Free Distribution Declaration**: **https://www.alicesoft.com/about/#cont08**. The eligible game is listed, but copyright is retained and its AliceSoft-brand content must not be distributed to anyone under 18; other conditions apply.
- User's assertion: **`aliceY3.hdi` was obtained by extracting this ZIP**. This has not been independently verified by inspecting the ZIP or comparing a checksum, file size, HDI geometry or contents.

The archive/listing identity has now been established *from the public listing*, resolving the main missing URL clue in #111. The archive **has not been downloaded or opened in this Issue**, and the site's listing does not by itself prove which other OS/drivers/files are included in the HDI or what third-party licensing terms attach to them.

### User-visible failure

On the **PC-9821Ap DOS** profile, mounting the local `aliceY3.hdi` as **IDE · HDI boot** (not as floppy), after the recent CPU/VM86/paging fixes, reportedly displays:

```text
FREEDOS(98) FAT KERNEL GO!
```

Then the screen fills with question-mark-like glyphs. Browser status remains **Running**; pressing Enter does **not** visibly change the image. No host error is reported. The text renderer's unsupported ANK glyph fallback can draw similar question marks from NUL/unrecognized text VRAM bytes, so **visible `?` does not prove literal `0x3F` bytes or a disk/CPU fault**. An original legal HDD control in PR #112 transiently showed 1,973 visible zero text cells at kernel handoff but still booted FreeCOM and accepted commands. Its success **does not** resolve the reported local-image failure.

## Expected outcome

Use the **now-identified archive provenance** to pursue an end-to-end, **lawful local-only** boot compatibility investigation. Where the implementer's environment is independently authorized and appropriate for age-restricted material, examine the exact ZIP/HDI *privately*, reproduce the symptom with the original Rust interpreter, identify and correct **cohesive, independently evidenced** CPU/BIOS/IDE/FreeDOS/PC-98 graphics or input defects, and retest for a responsive DOS prompt and game launch/interaction where possible. Implement fixes with **original Rust only**, backed by separate **rights-cleared independent fixtures** in native and production-Wasm acceptance.

**Do not demand or claim complete commercial game playability merely by fixing one observed symptom.** Do not close this Issue for only adding telemetry or passing the existing legal shell fixture: those milestones were already completed in #111/#112. If an independent large feature remains missing, document an exact reproducible blocker and open linked, cohesive `task` Issues. If private media cannot be acquired under the implementer's environment's applicable terms/age restrictions, keep it explicitly *not tested*, make all possible progress with legal controls, and do not misrepresent that as reproduction of this HDI.

## Source/age/licensing and operational boundaries

1. **Source check before retrieval:** verify the live [distribution page](https://alicefree.fastlast.org/), its `アリスの館3(PC-98版)` link, and the latest official [AliceSoft distribution terms](https://www.alicesoft.com/about/#cont08). The website asks anyone under 18 not to use the files. **Only** an agent/operator legally eligible and permitted by its environment/organization should retrieve age-restricted media. Do not spoof adulthood, circumvent age/access gates, ignore terms, or use alternate unauthorized mirrors. The authorized downloadable game is **not** necessarily authorization for the HDI's bundled FreeDOS, font, drivers or utilities; inspect each component's licensing separately. Never assume `alice_yakata3.zip` is the same content as a similarly named CD-image archive.
2. **Private local-only working copy:** if permitted, download ZIP into a **private, nontracked folder outside the Git checkout**, validate ZIP integrity, list members and confirm exact `aliceY3.hdi` path, compare format/geometry/size and identify actual boot/kernel/driver components, keeping any contents, hash records and raw logs private. Preserve the original intact and test a separately copied image. **Never commit, stage, push, attach, include in GitHub Issue/PR/review, GitHub Actions/CI/artifacts or Pages**, or redistribute the ZIP/HDI, adult game content, CG/audio, saves, proprietary fonts/ROM/BIOS, raw memory dumps, guest code/disassembly or full execution traces. A short noncopyrighted technical summary is acceptable. Avoid publishing explicit game screenshots.
3. **Unavailable image is not a blocker:** if downloading or inspecting the archive is disallowed, blocked, technically unavailable, or the HDI's additional components have unclear legal terms, **do not retrieve/use it**. Report the exact access/provenance/legal blocker; proceed with the existing GPL FreeDOS(98) HDD fixture and original MIT CPU/device tests, and develop lawful independently reproducible alternatives. Never claim an actual game retest.
4. **No third-party emulator implementation:** observing another PC-98 emulator as a private black box may be useful if lawfully allowed; do not copy/translate/fork its CPU/device code, do not import emulation dependencies, and do not use an illicit BIOS/ROM/font dump. Keep the focus on DOS games, **not Windows**.

## Investigation and correction plan

1. Establish the exact `main` commit, Ap/IDE profile, ZIP listing/HDI identity if lawfully accessible, partition/boot geometry, BIOS/FAT information and FreeDOS(98) version. A verified clean extraction matters: the user's original media and any agent-local image may not be identical without checks.
2. **Reproduce the exact failure locally only if permitted.** Reuse PR #112's bounded read-only `--progress` observations, e.g.
   ```sh
   cargo run --locked --release --bin headless -- /private/local/aliceY3.hdi 20000000 --progress --ap
   ```
   The path is illustrative. Retain trace/logs locally and share only high-level CPU/BIOS/IDE/text-VRAM metadata. The progress reporter shows instruction repetition/faults, PIC/PIT, IDE state/BIOS disk calls, and raw text-VRAM summaries distinguishing actual `3F` vs fallback glyphs. Use focused, bounded checkpoints and the existing `trace` option when appropriate, without publishing copyrighted code streams.
3. **Find first divergence:** compare kernel handoff and later CPU/mode/interrupt/IDE state with the [known-working legal HDD control](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/docs/hdd-boot-investigation.md), which passes interactive DOS commands. Specifically distinguish a transient 1,973 NUL-cell fallback from persistent visible `?`, test keyboard/IRQ response and actual guest forward progress, and locate the *first* architectural discrepancy rather than guessing.
4. Inspect HDI geometry/IDE CHS-vs-LBA/sector returns, loader's entry point and kernel-memory bytes, BPB/FAT configuration, driver init, paging/VM86 transitions, PC-98 BIOS services, keyboard/IRQ delivery, Japanese ANK/JIS text/attribute planes and rendering **as implicated by observations**. Use independently authored legal test guests for any failure and verify fail-before/pass-after. Investigate the guest kernel source/version from lawful sources, not proprietary disassembly.
5. Implement multiple **related evidenced defects as a coherent change**, not one unplanned opcode workaround at a time. Run back-to-back local retests against the actual private HDI only if legitimate access exists, seeking sustained FreeDOS shell progress, keyboard responsiveness and, optionally, game start/input. A rendered screen changing without actual DOS progress is not success.
6. Produce a rights-safe, reproducible technical report: archive/listing and eligibility **facts** checked; whether ZIP/HDI was **actually** retrieved and locally tested; whether the actual symptom reproduced; CPU/device/VRAM root cause evidence; legal regression fixtures with exact tests; before/after result and remaining limitations. If no private image was used, explicitly mark findings as from independent controls only.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Record and link this **exact user-provided ZIP URL** and verified PC-98 download-list entry, differentiate it from the CD-image link, read the current official conditional AliceSoft rights statement and decide whether the implementation environment may legally obtain age-restricted material. Distinguish game rights from any bundled OS/drivers/utility rights. An eligible local download and private inspection are **optional**, not mandatory approval requirements.
- [ ] Reuse and, if justified, extend the **bounded `--progress`** investigation from #112 to detect a no-host-error loop, CPU faults, PIC/PIT/BIOS/IDE events and raw text-VRAM `3F`/fallback counts; build independently reproducible checks. Do not publish copyrighted media, detailed traces or private screenshots.
- [ ] Compare **known-good original/legal FreeDOS(98) HDD shell boot** to the reported symptom: assert loader handoff, actual guest kernel bytes, FreeCOM prompt, keyboard and real `PROBE`/`ECHO OK` execution cold/reset. Document the controlled baseline rather than mislabeling passing tests as a bug fix.
- [ ] For every actual emulator defect diagnosed and corrected, include a specific **new original or rights-cleared minimal guest regression** that fails before and passes after, as well as coherent CPU/BIOS/IDE/rendering analysis. No guest filename or commercial-game hardcoded workarounds; do not fake PC-98 hardware state or guest control flow.
- [ ] Document what is **not yet independently reproducible**. If a lawfully accessible copy allows local-only retesting, report whether the `FAT KERNEL GO!` stage progresses, `?` persists, a responsive shell/game becomes reachable and the next genuine blocker. **No commercial disk, manual playthrough or adult content may be required for pre-merge or CI.**
- [ ] Apply all documented fixture preparation/license checks and run `cargo test --locked`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, production Rust/Wasm build and approved-assets audit, and **real-Wasm Chromium tests at both `/` and `/pc98-rust/` before merge** for changed emulator code. No private ZIP/HDI or adult content in any build, web asset, PR or CI.
- [ ] **Do not prematurely close this continuation:** a PR may claim `Closes` only after its bounded mandatory investigation and correction acceptance are complete. If only a partial investigation is possible, explicitly say so, leave the Issue open, and create a linked continuation `task` if Git automation administratively closes it anyway. Do not claim game playability without actual verification.

All **mandatory** tests must be executable by an AI implementer with legally redistributable fixtures; private image access, human playtest, adult-age access checks, physical PC-98 hardware, published Pages testing and post-merge deployment may **not** be pre-merge blockers.

## Optional validation

In a legitimately eligible private local environment, obtain the exact user-provided archive, check the extracted HDI's identity and license-separated components, run bounded black-box guest comparisons and test the game through a responsive shell, without uploading any media or adult gameplay output.

## Required post-merge verification

None. Deployment-only failures should become new `task` Issues and must not block this Issue's implementation review.
